name: pulse-metronome-android
description: Pulse Metronome Android wrapper built with Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
